description: What the signed-in person likes, wants to avoid, and their sizes, so gifts sent to them fit. Senders never see these; they only shape the suggestions senders get. Leave everything out to read them; with values, save:"preview" (default) shows the change and save:"save" keeps it.

save.description: preview (default) shows what would happen and keeps nothing; save does it. Only use save after the person said yes to the preview.

name: gift_preferences
title: My gift preferences
